<What Telegram knows about you

You can easily check what it knows by clicking on Settings->Privacy and Security->Show all sessions

There you can see each device you logged in, its ip, and its location (got by the ip). So if you don't like Telegram knowing anything, you might want to use a vpn. Also make sure to check if there is any session that you don't recognize, if there is one maybe your account has been hacked. Don't worry, if someone would try to log in your account Telegram should notify you.

<Two step verification and privacy settings

The first thing you want to do once you are signed in telegram is creating a cloud password to protect your account. Even if someone has your number and menages to login with that into your account, Telegram would ask him your password. As it already happened (https://t.me/theultimateredpill/1912), this will prevent strangers to steal your information. Also make sure to set all the privacy setting to the highest protection possible, like preventing people to see your account from a forwarded massage or (this option will come out in the next update) not making your contacts be able to see your number if they don't have your phone number as well.

<Contacts and exploits

As the privacy option mentioned earlier still isn't available, don't add strangers to your contacts. If someone comes to you and asks you to add his number, don't do it. That's definetly a trick, if you add him to your contacts he would be able to see your number as well, then you would be doxed. You don't want that, right?

Just to be sure, delete any synced contact you have and disable the sync contacts option from the privacy and security tab.

Now you might feel safer, but there is something you might fear: someone getting your number through a contacts generator.

If you are a known user someone could do it in order to dox you, but do not worry, we'll easily overcome this, just keep reading.

<Using a fake phone number

There are lots of companies that would let you have another phone number, just look for the free ones. Once you get a new phone number use it to log in telegram and set a password so that no one else can steal your profile.

There you are, even if they manage to get your number phone all they will have now is a fake one, with no link with you. Use this new account as your main one and never show the account with your real phone number, even better yet delete it.

"Whats wrong with just changing the number of my account with the fake one?" you might ask, you can do that actually, but your contacts will get your newer phone number, so they now will know both your numbers.

"What if I deleted all my synced contacts", if you trust Telegram that it's not storing your old number then yea you can do that.

With this new fake account you can join any channel without fearing of that being a honeypot (yea channel admins can see who joined their channel, don't join any channel with a account with your real number unless you trust the owner).

Have fun.
